class.name: AudioStreamMIDIBase
class.brief_description: Shared OPL3 synthesizer configuration for [AudioStreamMIDI] and [AudioStreamMIDISequencer].
class.description: Abstract base class shared by [AudioStreamMIDI] and [AudioStreamMIDISequencer], holding the libADLMIDI OPL3 synthesizer configuration common to both: emulated chip count ([member num_chips]), instrument bank ([member embedded_bank], or [member bank_data] for a custom WOPL bank), emulator core ([member emulator]), volume scaling curve ([member volume_model]), four-operator channel count ([member four_op_channels]), and brightness handling ([member full_range_brightness]). This class can't be instantiated directly. Use [AudioStreamMIDI] to play a MIDI file, or [AudioStreamMIDISequencer] to drive the synthesizer live with no fixed song.

members.member: Raw bytes of a custom WOPL instrument bank to load. Takes priority over [member embedded_bank] when non-empty.
Index of one of libADLMIDI's built-in instrument banks to use. Ignored if [member bank_data] is set. See [method AudioStreamMIDI.get_bank_count] and [method AudioStreamMIDI.get_bank_name].
Which OPL3 chip emulator core libADLMIDI uses to render audio (Nuked, DOSBox, Opal, YMFM, ESFMu, MAME, and others).
Number of four-operator channels to allocate across all emulated chips. [code]-1[/code] lets libADLMIDI choose automatically based on the loaded bank.
If [code]true[/code], MIDI CC74 (brightness) scales over the full 0-127 range instead of the default 0-64.
Number of OPL3 chips to emulate. More chips increase the polyphony limit.
Volume scaling curve libADLMIDI applies to note velocity, matching the behavior of a specific driver or sound card.
